finite_horizon_optimality.horizon_scope: A nonnegative finite number of attempted repairs fixed before the random history; every branch must restore a legal exact sharp-q=1 code; no postselection or halting to evade attempts.
finite_horizon_optimality.optimizes: number of classical core-label interventions, not source pulses, physical work, or record storage

geometry.universal_occupation_proof: For each safe exterior j, square B_j obeys B_j*B_j=w_j I2, hence B_j B_j*=w_j I2; sum_j w_j=1 and scalar V*n_aV imply V*n_aV=I2/2.

exact.optimality_domain: Every complete uniform-seam/fair-coin attempt starts in an exact all-seam sharp-q=1 qubit; native current transports the core; arbitrary adaptive/randomized legal-core resets are counted, including preemptive resets; immediate accurate quantum recovery is supplied.
exact.optimality_proof: h(edge)=150,h(distance_two)=120,h(antipodal)=0 drops by one in conditional expectation per native attempt. Every counted reset raises h by at most150. Telescope to obtain the universal bound. Boundary-only antipodal-to-edge resets raise h by150 and attain asymptotic rate1/150.
exact.reset_policy: Preserve the recorded native core unless antipodal; then use the attempted seam.
